words.meaning: to make a light or machine start working
words.japaneseMeaning: 電源を入れる・明かりをつける
words.example: Please turn on the kitchen light.

sentencePractice.prompt: It is dark in here. Please ____ the light so we can see.
sentencePractice.reviewNote: Starting the light provides illumination; switching it off or tidying cannot do that.

words.meaning: to make a light or machine stop working
words.japaneseMeaning: 電源を切る・明かりを消す
words.example: Turn off the television before bed.

words.meaning: to lift something with your hand
words.example: Please pick up the pencil from the floor.

words.meaning: to place something you are holding on a surface
words.example: Put down the hot cup carefully.

words.meaning: to move into a sitting position
words.example: Please sit down on this chair.

words.meaning: to move from sitting to a position on your feet
words.example: Please stand up when I call your name.

words.meaning: to make a place clean and tidy
words.example: We clean up the kitchen after dinner.

words.meaning: to wash plates and cups after a meal
words.example: I cook, and my brother helps me wash up.
words.usageNote: 食器を洗う意味では主にイギリス英語。アメリカ英語では do the dishes が一般的です。

words.meaning: to wash your body under water falling from above
words.example: I take a shower after football practice.

words.meaning: to put the covers on a bed neatly
words.example: I make the bed before I leave my room.
